_README: Every human judgement about this ROM lives in this file; the
generated listings are disposable, so renaming is free.
What to do next, roughly in order:
Read the coverage it reports. Low coverage is normal at
first and is the number you are trying to move.
2. Every unresolved indirect jump it reports is a hole. Add the
target to `entries`, or the pointer pair to `ram_vectors` if
the handler is installed into RAM.
Finds the sound code and the tables feeding it.
4. Name things in `labels` as soon as you know what they are.
See docs/method.md for the working order and docs/pitfalls.md for
the traps that each cost real time.

comments.rom:E34D: 32 units of edits queued: stop running objects this frame

headers.rom:91E3:
RunObjects: round-robin over slots 1-$52. Each live slot's timer is decremented once a
pass; at -1 its type's handler runs. Stops when the display-edit budget is reached
(SchedStop) or the bottom-of-playfield interrupt clears LogicWindow, remembers the
cursor, and calls DlDrain. Live: docs/FINDINGS.md section 1.
headers.rom:DEAA:
DlDrain: apply queued display-list edits. Runs only between the bottom-of-playfield
interrupt (line 232) and the top one (line 56). Per object, ObjState bits say what to do:
$08/$04 rewrite the header in the first/second zone, $20/$10 remove it, $80/$40 append
it to a new zone's list.
headers.rom:E005:
DlRemoveHeader: delete by moving the zone's last header into the hole, repointing its
owner (ObjHdrLo/Hi or ObjHdr2Offset), and zeroing the vacated last header's second byte.
headers.rom:E1AF:
DlQueueMove: compare the object's zones in the lists (ObjZones) with the zones of the
proposed position ($BF/$C1), set the edit bits, count the work in $B7, refuse (MoveRefused
= 1, proposed Y put back) if a zone to enter already holds 23 enemies, then DlEnqueue.
headers.rom:BD6E:
DirToward: direction from object X to object Y by comparing box edges; $0F = touching.
$B7 non-zero keeps one axis of a diagonal at random (4-direction movers).
headers.rom:BCDC:
AimAt: velocity from object X toward point ($B8,$B9): |dx|,|dy| halved together until
both are under a limit; $AA = a period that shortens with distance.
